## About these books

They were authored to supplement the courses at
[Rsquared Academy](https://www.rsquaredacademy.com). Some are beginner friendly
while others assume prior familiarity with a topic.

They began as blog posts, expanded into tutorials, and were eventually
rewritten into short books with the sharp edges filed off. The style is
deliberately plain — short chapters, worked examples, and the parts of the
documentation people usually skip.

None of them replaces the official [R documentation](https://www.r-project.org/).
If you want one place to start, **Introduction to R** is the one.

If these were useful, the courses behind them are at
[rsquaredacademy.com](https://www.rsquaredacademy.com/).
